fluff.overview: ComStar's infantry served across the Inner Sphere in garrison and security roles, stationed on HPG compound worlds where they provided protection for the Order's most critical infrastructure while maintaining the facade of a purely defensive force. Motorized platoons use light vehicles to achieve ground speeds well beyond foot infantry, allowing rapid redeployment between defensive positions. Their wheeled or motorcycle transport keeps the formation mobile on developed road networks, though off-road performance is limited. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
